de: Besuchen Sie das Webb Ellis Museum während der Rugby-Saison.

Rugby ist gut zu Fuß erreichbar.

A Caldecott Park ideális hely egy piknikhez.
Rugby városa gyalogosan is jól bejárható.
ro: Vizitați muzeul Webb Ellis în timpul sezonului de rugby.

en: Visit the Webb Ellis Museum during the rugby season.
Caldecott Park is ideal for a summer picnic.
Rugby is a very compact and walkable town.
